title.narrative: The WASH Sector continued to strengthen the normative and programmatic framework to create an enabling environment for sustainable access to WASH services. In 2024 a climate rationale for water, sanitation and the hygiene sector was developed, a document which has shed more light on strategies to adopt climate-resilient WASH services.
Extent to which national and local government frameworks for preparedness and/or early/anticipatory action are updated to be and child sensitive at the national and local levels
Existence of an integrated humanitarian-development-peace nexus approach to WASH programming through the participation of affected populations

Extent to which child-sensitive programmes enhance the climate and disaster resiliene of children, reduce environmental degradation and promote low carbon development and environmental sustainability with UNICEF support
Extent to which a climate rationale for the impact of climate change and water scarcity on WASH services has been developed
Extent to which annual WASH sector expenditures from different funding and financing sources have increased with UNICEF support
Existence of a national plan to provide access to drinking water and sanitation for unserved populations, Text
Existence of an online database updated and accessible to all actors at all times, Text
Extent to which the national monitoring system incorporates sustainability data from within the past two years, with UNICEF support
Extent to which a costed and inclusive WASH financing strategy has been prepared and implemented with UNICEF support
